name: sdd
description: A spec-driven workflow with lightweight milestone memory: /milestone clarifies the intended outcome, tracks Todo not yet represented by epics, and optionally syncs progress read-only from Beads; /specify authors stories/epics, /refine revises them, /board renders the backlog, /solve implements one in an isolated worktree, /validate merges after human review, and /orchestrate automates a whole epic behind one final PR. Also ships code-review-quality and writing-claude-md.
author: nadiar <codex@nadiar.id>

interface.shortDescription: Track a milestone, then author, solve, validate, and orchestrate stories.
interface.longDescription: Clarify and keep the current milestone in .milestone.md, including Todo not yet represented by epics, optionally sync epic progress read-only from Beads, then manage the engineering workflow from story authoring through isolated implementation, human-reviewed merge, and whole-epic orchestration behind a single final PR. Ships all three marketplace plugins as one Kimi plugin.
